# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta24

## Cleaner Displayed information editor

- Remove the repetitive **Show** prefix from visibility toggles.
- Reorganize **Displayed information** into a stable logical order instead of feature-creation order:
  - **Mower information** — Status, Physical zone, Battery, X/Y position.
  - **Map elements** — Zone labels, label-overlap handling, VisionFence/VF-off, Gate areas, Channels, Custom areas and Map legend.
  - **History** — Session times and History days.
  - **Header buttons** — History, Notifications, Schedule and Settings.
- Keep all existing YAML keys and defaults unchanged; this is an editor presentation change only.

## LiDAR editor capability visibility

- Hide the **LiDAR overlay** editor section for ordinary non-LiDAR mower cards.
- Detect i2 LiDAR from the selected mower entity's model metadata already exposed by the Navimower integration.
- Keep the section available for Multi mower mode when a LiDAR mower is present, and keep it visible when an existing YAML configuration already selects a LiDAR terrain/elevation overlay so the setting can always be changed back.
- Runtime LiDAR rendering remains integration-capability driven and unchanged.
